about: E42 Amendment 1, masked teacher training on a behaviour the model lacks (reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_e42-teacher-new-behaviour.md -> 'Amendment 1'). Tasks rand32 then rand1 (E10's key -> value windows, 403 train and 97 held-out each), one task per job. Teacher: E42's (arm A's loss with the table target, all 24 matrices, Adam 3e-5, batch 32, seed 0, step 1000), regenerated. Arm M: E42's arm A (task windows, Adam 1e-5, batch 32, batch-order seed 0, 1000 steps, Gamma and Delta frozen) with commute.masked_copy's loss: arm-A-weighted KL(teacher || unmasked student) + 0.5 x the same for the CI-masked student (masks = Gamma's g on the student's activations, Delta out) + 0.5 x the same for the stochastic-masked student (g + (1 - g) r, Delta under its own random mask, all layers). Step 100 read without the Pile harness, step 1000 with it. Filed before any run

controls.C1: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check. Expected: pass, floor 0.2088 on an L40 (E42's), pass line 1.24, fail line 1.81. Stop
controls.G1: E42's: the regenerated teacher's held-out P(target) at step 10 within 0.02 of E10's (rand32 0.5847, rand1 0.9982). Stop
controls.G2: the trainer's unmasked term with the teacher at W0, on its first batch: the component path's KL to the target model, arm A's weighting. Expected about 1e-3 (E37 Amendment 1: 0.00065 per Pile position). Above 0.01: stop (the trainer's forward is not the model's)
controls.M0: alone, before the teacher: the masked recipe with the teacher at W0, 1000 steps, Pile harness. Expected: held-out P(target) and trigger CI-masked P(target) at W0's values (both under 1e-3), damage elsewhere under 0.02, both Pile ratios 'pass' or 'inconclusive'. Either Pile ratio 'fail' (faith_score.verdict against this job's floors), or any Pile ratio NaN: stop, arm M not run (the recipe moves the decomposition with nothing to copy, as E37 Amendment 1's masked control did). 'inconclusive': arm M runs; a fail or inconclusive of arm M is then not attributed to copying
